purpose: Measured baseline of the ANUS suite so a later session never has to re-derive it from zero. Compare against this before blaming your own change: a failure listed here is pre-existing and is NOT a regression.

howToReproduce.warning: never `npx vitest` — it returns nothing on this host; never pipe to tail and read $? — that returns tail's exit code and has hidden a real failure before
howToReproduce.liveNote: LIVE missions under src/__tests__/live/ are excluded from the baseline: they call a real model over the network, cost quota, and their verdict depends on the executor rather than on this repo. Run them deliberately, one file at a time.

suite.note: exitCode 1 is the EXPECTED steady state on this host. The suite is not green and must never be reported as green.

typecheck.note: exitCode 2 with exactly these 3 errors is the expected steady state. A 4th error is yours.

cases: install: build + health green from isolated state dirs
upgrade: rebuild preserves exec-graph + goal budget state
rollback: restore prior dist; state + health still valid
knownFailures.cause: `npx tsup` is not resolvable on this host's PATH inside vitest's child-process context
its beforeAll tsup build fails for the same PATH reason; its 10 tests then report as skipped and are part of the 12 skipped

regressionsFoundAndFixedThisSession.cause: src/atlas/executor/tool-broker.ts calls filesystem mutators and was not classified in STATE_WRITER_INVENTORY; the structural test discovers writers independently, so an unregistered writer fails by design
regressionsFoundAndFixedThisSession.fix: registered as configuration-content / caller-target — mission-worktree writes only, nothing under ATLAS_STATE_ROOT
